test_transform_roundtrip: test that Affine, Exponentiate, TanhBound, ArctanBound, CumulativeDensity, Clipping, and Fourrier transforms round-trip correctly via forward then backward
test_transform_forward_values: test that transform forward methods produce expected numerical output for given input arrays
test_transform_out_of_bounds: test that transform backward methods raise ValueError when given out-of-bounds input values
test_multibounds_transform: test multi-dimensional bound transforms like TanhBound, ArctanBound, and Clipping with per-dimension bounds
test_clipping_transform: test Clipping transform forward behavior with both single-sided and double-sided clipping bounds
